tasks.title: Sign out everywhere
phrasings: Add a way to sign out of every device at once: a new endpoint `POST /logout/all` (login required) that ends every session of the signed-in user, including the one making the request, and returns 204. Other users' sessions must keep working. Cover it in the contract tests.

People want a "sign out everywhere" button. Build the API side of it: `POST /logout/all` needs a login, ends all of the caller's sessions (the current one too) and answers 204 with no body. Nobody else's sessions are affected. Add contract tests.

Someone who loses a laptop should be able to end all their sessions. Implement `POST /logout/all`. It requires a login, ends every session that belongs to the calling user, including the calling session, and returns 204. Sessions of other users stay valid. Include contract tests.
